slides.title: Stop being *everyone's* reminder.
slides.sub: Memopai can remind Mom, your kid or your flatmate, in their own WhatsApp.

body: The reminder lands in *her* WhatsApp, every day.
You can add up to 10 people.

lines: You stop nagging. Everyone stays on time.
